name: Camping 101: Fishing
summary: In Brill, someone hopes your fishing skill will bring cheer to camp. Clyde Kellen can teach you to make a fishbowl for it.

sections.title: A Camp Keepsake
sections.body:
Your fishing may brighten the camp. Once you've proved your skill, speak with Clyde Kellen in Brill. He can teach you to make a fishbowl for the camp.

The giver believes cheerful adventurers fight more strongly. They hope the fishbowl will bring joy to you and the others.

faq.q: What am I being asked to do?
faq.answer: Prove your fishing skill, then speak with Clyde Kellen in Brill. He can teach you to make a fishbowl for your camp.
Clyde Kellen is in Brill and can teach you to make a fishbowl for your camp.
The fishbowl is meant to bring joy to you and the other adventurers at camp.

faq.q: Why would fishing help the camp?
faq.answer: Your fishing skill can help you make a fishbowl. The giver hopes it will cheer the adventurers.

angles.text: As an angler, you can use your fishing skill to make a fishbowl for your camp.
